Offline product image cutout uses the IS-Net general-use model.
Model authors: Xuebin Qin et al., Highly Accurate Dichotomous Image Segmentation.
Source: https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS
ONNX distribution: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0
Model identity and checksum: cutout_model.json in the runtime resource directory.
Upstream license text is included in IS-Net-LICENSE.txt.
Input/output normalization follows the documented IS-Net general-use inference
contract also used by rembg. The desktop implementation uses ONNX Runtime CPU
inference and never downloads model files at application runtime.
